intro: Solara transforms your bedroom into a retreat. With its quilted headboard, angled back, and soft upholstery, it invites you to lean back, relax, and savor unhurried moments of rest every night. Plush comfort or firm support - the Restomagic Dual let's you choose. The dual-sided mattress allows for with two firmness levels, so whatever your needs, you wake up rested and ready for the day.

features.title: Angled headboard that supports you
features.text: Unlike flat designs, the gently sloped back reduces strain on shoulders and spine, so you read, watch, or relax without discomfort

features.title: Quilted back for comfort and style
features.text: Generously padded and upholstered, the headboard feels soft to lean on, while cross-quilted patterns bring depth and a tailored look

features.title: Ample underbed storage for all your needs
features.text: A spacious storage base keeps bedding, cushions, or seasonal items hidden yet handy, helping your room stay neat and uncluttered

features.title: Pebble brown finish that warms interiors
features.text: Synthetic leather in pebble brown adds earthy richness, blending beautifully with different wardrobes and bedside tables

features.title: Comfort on both sides, your way
features.text: Crave flexibility? Our dual-sided mattress lets you pick between plush comfort and firm support—so your bed adjusts to you.

features.title: Soft quilting adds an extra layer of comfort
features.text: Your bed should welcome you the moment you lie down, and our plush quilted top does exactly that, offering soft, breathable comfort that helps you unwind with ease.

name: Solara Queen Size Engineered Wood Box Storage Bed And Mattress Combo
